results.title: The 6 Software Tools Most Golf Clubs Are Using | Parfour
results.content:
## Related guides

SoftwareWhat to Look for in Golf Tournament Software AlternativesRead article →EventsGolf Tournament Management Software: The Complete GuideRead article →EventsHow to Organize a Golf Tournament From Start to FinishRead article → [...] ## Parfour brings the operation together

Parfour combines major pieces of the club experience:

 Memberships
 Events
 Registration
 Payments
 Player data
 Scoring
 Leaderboards
 Seasons
 Communication
 Public club pages
 Ecommerce
 Sponsorships
 Donations
 Reporting

Instead of building your club around the software stack, the software starts to operate around the club.

## The biggest feature is not having to move the data

A golfer registers once. Their information exists. They join the club. Their membership exists. They enter another event. The platform already knows them. They score. The results connect. They join a season. The points connect.

That is the difference between having a collection of software products and having an actual operating system for your golf organization. [...] ## 3. Spreadsheets

The spreadsheet becomes the unofficial database. Members. Players. Payments. Pairings. Standings. Everything eventually finds its way there.

## 4. Communication

Mailchimp, text messages, Discord, WhatsApp, and group chats keep everyone informed. Except now the organizer has multiple audiences in multiple places.

## 5. Scoring software

When the event begins, everyone moves into another platform for golf scoring.

## 6. Website and ecommerce

The public club experience and merchandise store often live somewhere else again.

## The problem is not that these tools are bad

Many of them are great at what they do. The problem is the gaps between them. Someone has to keep the data connected. Usually that someone is the club organizer.
